name: How long does bathroom plumbing installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom plumbing installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of bathroom plumbing installation can vary depending on the scope of the project. A simple replacement of existing fixtures might take a day or two. A complete new installation for a full bathroom, including rough-in plumbing, could take anywhere from 3 to 7 business days, especially if it's part of a larger renovation. Factors like the size of the bathroom, complexity of the design, and any unforeseen issues can influence the timeline.
